nights.title: Soner Sarıkabadayı
nights.name: Soner Sarıkabadayı
nights.extract: Soner Sarıkabadayı is a Turkish pop music singer and songwriter.

nights.title: Rafet El Roman
nights.name: Rafet El Roman
nights.extract: Rafet Yaşdut, better known by his stage name Rafet El Roman, is a Turkish pop singer. He holds German citizenship.

nights.name: Ayşegül Aldinç
nights.extract: Ayşegül Aldinç is a Turkish singer and actress.

nights.title: İlkay Akkaya
nights.name: İlkay Akkaya
nights.extract: İlkay Akkaya is a Turkish singer and member of the Turkish music group Grup Kızılırmak.

nights.title: Ogün Sanlısoy
nights.name: Ogün Sanlısoy
nights.extract: Ogün Sanlısoy is a Turkish musician, vocalist and guitarist for thrash metal band Mezarkabul.

nights.title: Demir Demirkan
nights.name: Demir Demirkan
nights.extract: Demir Demirkan is a Turkish musician, Eurovision Song Contest winning composer, guitarist for thrash metal band Mezarkabul and writer. Demirkan started playing music when he was 13 and played guitar with various groups in college. He also wrote television jingles and composed soundtracks for television and films.
